accuracy_formula: mean_b(max_v count_b(v)/N); every one of the N keys is queried exactly once, so fixed argmax predictions attain this exactly on the observed labels.
cross_entropy_formula: mean_b[-sum_{v:count_b(v)>0} (count_b(v)/N)*log(count_b(v)/N)] (natural logarithms). This is the minimum mean log-loss for a single shared query distribution restricted to the sequence value bag.
description: Exact validation-set oracle within the family of key-blind, per-sequence value-histogram predictors; not a general lower bound on attention models.
interpretation: Raw softmax 6000-update losses near 2.70 nats and accuracy near 10% are consistent with this bag predictor. Agreement alone does not prove the trained network uses it; the shared-convolution intervention tests the binding hypothesis.
probability_rule: For every query in sequence b, p_b(v)=count of v among its N context values / N. Ignore query identity and key/value associations.
reproduction: Call diag.mqar(np.random.default_rng(10000),256,T=128,N=16,V=256); bincount each row of x[:,1:32:2], divide by16; average modal probability and entropy.
